page.title: Sky – al-Marṣad
page.description: The whole graph of the Seerah as a sky you can turn: the Prophet ﷺ as the light at the centre, the people as stars lit by their recorded generation, and every recorded link as a line. Every claim is proposed and not yet reviewed.
banner.text: Everything here is a proposal. Every claim in the graph is “proposed” and none has been reviewed by a scholar yet. The Sky draws every mark sharp, so the status is on every row of the panel and in the legend instead of a texture. Folded detail is one tap away, never removed.
banner.text.plain: Nothing here has been checked by scholars yet. Tap any star to see where it comes from.
canvas.label: Sky view, {frame}: {shown} of {total} items. Drag to turn it. The text view below describes it.
morph.note: Drag to morph: the same marks move between the Sky and the flat Time, Geography, Stories and Transmission views, which lie in one plane inside it. Positions are worked out in advance and never re-solved.
keys.help: Keys: arrows turn · Shift + arrows move · + and − zoom · 0 fits · Enter focuses the mark at the centre · Esc steps back · / finds a name.
intro.title: One sky, five views
intro.how: Drag to turn the sky, pinch or scroll to zoom, and tap any star to focus it: its relationships, events, places, stories, generation and evidence appear here together. Change the view below the picture, play history, scrub a period, or start from a vantage point.
legend.motion: Motion: only when you turn, zoom, flick or change the view, or press Play history or Orbit. Nothing drifts on its own.
textalt.frame.network: Sky view: the Prophet ﷺ is the light at the centre. The 50 Stories are on a ring around it in reading order. People with a recorded generation sit on a shell for it, Companions nearest the light. Everything else sits by its recorded links. A three-dimensional layout worked out in advance.
textalt.region.network.light: The light at the centre is the Prophet ﷺ.
textalt.region.network.shell: {n} people sit on the shell of their recorded generation.
textalt.region.network.free: {n} items sit by their recorded links (no generation recorded, or not a person).
textalt.region.network.unlinked: {n} items have no recorded link yet.
footer.built: Built from the unified graph, like the Observatory, which shows the same records flat. The reader pages carry them without JavaScript.
sky.views.label: Viewpoint
sky.options.label: Sky options
sky.orbit_reduced: Orbit stays off: your device asks for reduced motion.
sky.announce.generation.on: Stars are lit by their recorded generation.
sky.announce.generation.off: Generation light off: every star is lit the same.
sky.announce.names.off: Names hidden, except for the focus and its links.
sky.announce.scenery.on: Distant stars shown. They are scenery, not records.
sky.announce.orbit.on: Orbit on: the sky turns slowly until you press Orbit again.
sky.announce.play: Playing history from {y}: each mark lights at its first dated record.
sky.announce.play_end: History played to the last recorded year.
sky.legend.prophet: The Prophet ﷺ: the light at the centre, the source of the light, not one mark among many
sky.legend.gen.sahabi: Companion (ṣaḥābī): brightest and coolest, nearest the light
sky.legend.gen.tabii: Successor (tābiʿī): warmer and dimmer, further out
sky.legend.gen.tabi_al_tabiin: Successor of the Successors: warmer and dimmer still
sky.legend.gen.none: Generation not recorded: plain, with no halo; placed by its links only
sky.legend.light_note: Brightness and warmth show the recorded generation (ṭabaqa) only: never importance, never how many links a person has. Switch it off with “Light by generation”.
sky.legend.rules: What else the Sky shows, and does not
sky.legend.review: Not yet reviewed: every claim today. Each row of the panel carries its status label.
sky.legend.position: Position: in the Sky, distance from the light is the recorded generation; everything else sits by its recorded links. In the flat views, the view's own axis. Dimmed marks are outside the focus, thread or period; hollow marks have no recorded date.
sky.legend.sharp: Every edge is sharp: nothing is blurred, so every star can be told apart and touched.
sky.legend.far: The faint pinpoints far behind are scenery, not records. Switch them off with “Distant stars”.
